# Xenon Design System (Zx)

> Xenon is a dependency-free design system for browser applications; Zx is its product-agnostic
> vanilla-JavaScript implementation. ES2022 modules, WAI-ARIA-accessible native
> controls, semantic `--zx-*` design tokens with light/dark theming and one token-driven geometry,
> and lifecycle-safe components. Source modules run directly in the browser; a build step emits ESM, IIFE-global,
> ZeyOS binding, and CSS bundles. Zero runtime dependencies.

Instantiate every component as `new Component(target, options)` where `target` is an Element, a
selector string, or `null` (the component creates and owns its root, retrieved via `.toElement()`).
Subscribe with `.on(type, fn)` or an `on<type>` option; handlers receive a `CustomEvent` whose
`.detail` is an object. Call `.destroy()` to clean up. The same API is available as ESM named
exports and as `window.zx.*`.

## Documentation
- [Documentation site](https://zx.zeyos.com/docs.html): supported APIs, live demos, and example source.
- [Locales guide](https://zx.zeyos.com/docs.html#getting-started/locales): add languages, regional catalogues, custom message keys, interpolation variables, plurals, and formatting options.
- [README](https://zx.zeyos.com/README.md): installation, component index, theming, and browser support.
- [API reference](https://zx.zeyos.com/docs/llms.md): options, methods, events, and core helpers.
- [Surface guide](https://zx.zeyos.com/docs/agent-surfaces.md): agent-authored surfaces and their reply contract.
- [Component catalogue](https://zx.zeyos.com/docs/agent-catalog.json): machine-readable surface component schemas.
- [Changelog](https://zx.zeyos.com/CHANGELOG.md): supported changes and upgrade notes.

## Start here: choosing
- Start every screen from the closest **layout**, never from a blank page. Gallery:
  https://zx.zeyos.com/layouts (`layouts.html#<id>` opens one); source
  `https://zx.zeyos.com/layouts/<id>.layout.js` + `<id>.layout.css`; the shell helpers
  `layouts/kit.js` + `kit.css`, and `layouts/overview.js` + `overview.css` (`createOverview()`,
  the toolbar-chips-drawers-pager composition every record screen uses). They are site modules,
  not package exports: copy them beside the application.
- Templates (complete applications on one shell): `mail`, `issue-tracker`, `wiki`, `ai-chat`,
  `agent-workspace`, `invoice-editor`, `item-inventory`, `workflows`, `infrastructure`, `crm`.
  Patterns (single screens): `master-detail`, `record-collection` (any list of records),
  `dashboard`, `inbox`, `record-page`, `agent-chat`, `record-wizard`, `checkout-wizard`,
  `settings-workspace`, `system-states` (every empty, loading, error, and confirmation state),
  `zeyos-invoices`.
- The agent reference's **"Choosing what to build with"** section maps each screen to its layout
  and each job to its component, lists the theming decisions (theme, accent preset, geometry
  tokens, material, motion, colour roles), and what never to build by hand. Read it before
  building anything.

## Components
- Foundations: `.zx-prose` (the reading register for authored content) and `.zx-callout`;
  `kbd()` (keycaps for every shortcut hint).
- Inputs: `button()`, `buttonGroup()`, `badge()`/`badgeGroup()`, `CheckButton`,
  `Toggle`, `Search`,
  `Select` (APG combobox; `filter: false|'local'|async`; priority, status, permission, and
  `Select.entity()` presets), `LocalePicker`/`CountryPicker` (Select over locales or ISO countries,
  `Intl`-named, with `flag()` emoji, code chip, or app-served flag images), `Checklist`, `TagPicker` (icon/color identity), `NumberField`, `Rating`, `Slider`,
  `copyButton()`/`CopyInput`, `DatePicker`, `MonthPicker`, `TimePicker`,
  `Datebox`/`DateTimeBox`, `DateRangePicker`/`DateRangeBox`, `Timebox`.
- Overlays: `Message` (toasts/inline/progress), `Modal`, `Dialog` (+ `alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` Promises), `Sheet` (edge-anchored Dialog; `side`, `modal: true|'trap-focus'|false`, `backdrop`, `snap` detents, swipe-to-dismiss), `SheetStack` (drill-down; `stack`/`cascade`), `Dropdown`, `MenuButton`, `ContextMenu` (right-click; `selector` for per-row menus), `Tooltip`/`tooltip()`/`describe()`.
- Data: `EntityRef` (dense linked/static identity), `FileItem`/`FileList` (durable and transient
  file presentation), `ActivityItem`/`ActivityList` (chronological entries and grouped feeds),
  `Table` (sortable, selectable, sticky header, opt-in inline cell/row editing, row reorder,
  column visibility), shared `RecordView` state through `TableView`, `CardView`, and `KanbanView`,
  `Grid` with single-click editing and `Grid.BillingItems()`, engine-neutral
  `Chart` with injected `ChartJsAdapter`, `Calendar` (agenda/day/week/month/year, pointer/keyboard
  drag and resize, `optimistic: true|false`), backend-neutral nested `Filter`, simple client-side
  `DataFilter`, `FilterPanel` (typed filter form built from a server's own field metadata;
  `mode: 'draft'|'live'`, `serialize`), `ListToolbar` (search, live result count, view switch, and
  tools whose badge is part of the accessible name), `ViewSettings` (view-settings drawer content:
  reorder, hide, and add fields, grouping, board axes; `bind()` to a record view),
  `Pagination` (+ pure `paginationRange()`),
  `SortControl` (searchable field selector with a direction toggle, one atomic `{id,dir}`),
  `TreeView` (APG tree), `Finder` (Miller columns).
- Forms: `Form`, `Fieldset`, `Questionnaire` (guided one-question-at-a-time flow with branching), `Field` (type registry), `CodeEditor` (structured text in a native textarea; never executes or injects the value), `ValueList`, `MultiValueEditor`, `FieldUpload`.
- Layout: `stack()`/`grid()`/`aspect()` (spacing, an intrinsically reflowing grid, a fixed-ratio
  box), `Groupbox`, `Card` (media/title link/actions/footer), `StatTile`/`statTile()` (labelled
  metric with optional delta, sparkline, and loading state), `AppIcon` (generic tile geometry;
  circular `zeyosAppIcon()` application presets and compact `moduleChip()` identities),
  `Aurora` (one- to four-colour ambient
  canvas light; shared material roles govern chrome and overlays), `Avatar` (person presence, or an
  agent's `activity` with an opt-in shared presence animation), `Panel` (header/footer action
  buttons), `MasterPanel`, `Tabbox`
  (`variant: 'divided'|'bracket'|'line'|'segmented'`), `NavigationBar`, `AppSidebar` (expanded and
  minimized vertical states plus horizontal rail layouts; sections; a modules layout), `ModuleBar`
  (colour-coded module strip or bar with flyout menus and an "All modules" catalogue), `AccountMenu`,
  `WorkspaceSwitcher` (workspace tile, name and menu at the head of a navigation column), `Launcher`,
  `spinner()`/`ProgressBar`/`InlineLoading`, `skeleton()`/`skeletonText()`/`skeletonTable()`,
  `Toolbar` (APG toolbar with overflow menu), `SplitView`, `Dock`
  (collapsible resizable pane stack; tab groups, regions, adopts a `Sheet`), `Stepper`,
  `Breadcrumb`, `emptyState()`.
- Agents: `AgentThread` (a conversation with agents as an APG feed: messages, streamed answers, run traces,
  approvals, notices; plain-JSON items, the application owns transport), `BlockView`/`renderBlocks()` (an
  answer drawn block by block as prose, appended to as it streams; model text is never HTML),
  `RunTrace` (the steps a run took: tool calls with arguments and results, retries, hand-offs),
  `ApprovalCard` (a request that holds a run: approve, edit, reject, typed confirmation),
  `SourceList` (cited sources with a card each; nothing remote is loaded), `Composer` (the message
  box: mentions, `/` commands, attachments, context chips, Send that becomes Stop), `PromptStarters`
  (starting points for an empty conversation; a pick is reported, never sent), `RunStatus` (a run's
  state, steps, working time, tokens, and a cost meter against a budget), `Surface` (a surface an
  agent composed as JSON, validated and drawn with library components; it ends in exactly one reply
  and stays as its receipt), `openSurface()`, `elicit()` (a form-mode elicitation as a dialog),
  `surfaceText()` (a reply's receipt as plain text).
- Core: `Component`, `h`/`__`/`icon`, `position`, `breakpoints`/`breakpointOf`/`matchBreakpoint`/`onBreakpoint` (named width bands, observed on an element or the window), `Http`/`zeyosService`, i18n, date utils, `defineElements` (declarative `<zx-*>` custom elements).
- Helpers: `formatNumber`/`formatCurrency`/`formatPercent`/`formatFileSize`/`formatRelativeTime` (locale-aware, cached `Intl`), `translatePlural(key, count, args, options)` and `Component.msgPlural(key, count, ...args)` (explicit count, cardinal forms), `debounce`/`throttle`, `groupBy`/`sortBy`/`uniqueBy`, `escapeRegExp`/`highlightMatch`, `storage()` (unambiguous namespaces, explicit `migrateLegacy(keys)`, degrades to memory), `toCsv`/`downloadBlob`/`copyToClipboard`, `truncate()`/`isTruncated()` (line clamp with the full value on hover).
- Locales: `locales/en.js`, `locales/de.js`, and opt-in `locales/index.js`; explicit locale, then active language, then English for formatting. ZeyOS module colours are opt-in through `styles/zeyos.css`.

## Theming
Load `zx.css` once; set `data-zx-theme` (`light`|`dark`|`auto`) on any ancestor. There is one geometry: spacing steps are multiples of `--zx-space-unit` (4px), radius steps are fractions of `--zx-radius` (4px: 2/3/4/6px), and controls are `--zx-control-height` (30px) tall — override those to tighten or loosen an application. Define a product theme by overriding semantic `--zx-color-*` / `--zx-control-*` tokens under `[data-zx-theme="name"]`. The theme studio controls accent, neutral tint, spacing, font, type size, radius, control height, and the CSS-first material: Glass (the default, a thin lit pane), Deep glass, Frost (milk glass), Smoke (tinted), Paper, Satin and Enamel (opaque, no blur), or Flat — each a token-override recipe composed from the theme's glass ingredients (`--zx-color-glass-rim/-ring/-lift/-shade/-edge/-tint`). Compact menus, pickers, tooltips, column menus, and toasts share responsive compact glass; Launcher, Modal, Dialog, and floating Sheets share a calmer reading panel. Both preserve scoped theme inheritance and refract Aurora/page content; docked Sheets and dense data surfaces remain opaque. Never use tier-1 palette tokens or raw color literals in application CSS.

## Talking to ZeyOS
Use the dedicated ZeyOS client library **`@zeyos/client`** (`npm install @zeyos/client`) for ZeyOS business data: `createZeyosClient({ platform, auth })`, typed `client.api.list/get/create/update<Resource>` over the full OpenAPI surface, and `normalizeListResult`. Zx accepts the client by injection and does not bundle it. See the `website/layouts/zeyos-invoices.layout.js` layout for a Zx-components-on-@zeyos/client reference. Zx also ships a minimal `Http`/`zeyosService` for ad-hoc in-app `remotecall`, but `@zeyos/client` is the recommended default.

The optional `./zeyos` entry maps schemas into all three record views. `SavedViewRegistry` adds
private named configurations scoped by authenticated user, workspace/fork (including null for the
base workspace), and resource through an injected atomic transport. The compatibility transport
reuses ZeyOS `userfields`; records, selection, pages, callbacks, and DOM are never persisted.

## Installing
`npm install @zeyos/zx`. Entry points: `.` (components), `./zeyos` (ZeyOS binding), `./zx.css`
(styles), and `./global` (classic script tag). Docs: https://zx.zeyos.com

## Commands
`npm run serve` (no-build documentation at http://127.0.0.1:8321/website/docs.html) · `npm test` (unit + token lint) · `npm run build` (dist bundles).
